papers.title_en: Multi-View In-Cabin Monitoring System for Public Transport Vehicles
papers.authors: Evgeny Gorelik, Kenny Dean Karrow, Fikret Sivrikaya, Sahin Albayrak, Christian Baumann
papers.evidence: 发布包含LiDAR和RGB-D的多视角车内数据集，提供3D边界框标注并基准评测3D检测模型
papers.tldr: 本文发布一个公共交通车内监测数据集，同步采集四路相机、深度和旋转LiDAR数据，提供9000余样本的三维人体边界框与姿态标注，并转换nuScenes格式以基准评测多视角三维检测模型，填补了车内多模态感知数据集的空白，为公共交通场景的3D感知研究提供支撑。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a multi-view in-cabin monitoring dataset for public transportation with synchronized RGB and depth images from four inward-facing cameras and a rotating LiDAR covering the vehicle interior of a digitalized and partly automated German city bus. The dataset contains 9.136 synchronized samples with annotations and is accompanied by a calibration and pseudo-labeling pipeline that generates 3D human pose estimates and oriented 3D bounding boxes for occupants. We further provide a nuScenes-format conversion and benchmark representative multi-view 3D detection models (e.g., Lift-Splat-Shoot and BEVFusion), supporting comparative evaluation and small-scale training of multi-view in-cabin perception models. The dataset and tools are available at https://github.com/EvgenyGorelik/multiview_incabin_dataset.
